review_status: Initial expository proofs; independent human review pending.

claims.label: prop:short
claims.statement: SAT truth tables have K(T_n) <= K(n) + O(1), and unrestricted local descriptions can have constant length.
claims.scope: Fixed decidable SAT encoding; no efficient decoding claim.

claims.label: thm:advice
claims.statement: Polynomial local description length and polynomial query time characterize SAT in P/poly.
claims.scope: Fixed efficiently universal deterministic evaluator; a description may depend only on input length.

claims.label: cor:target
claims.statement: The quantified infinitely-often local lower bound is equivalent to SAT not in P/poly and implies P != NP.
claims.scope: All fixed polynomial description/time exponents; the converse from P != NP is not claimed.

claims.label: lem:count
claims.statement: At most 2^(s+1)-1 tables have local descriptions of at most s bits for a fixed time bound.
claims.scope: Counting all Boolean tables, not an explicit SAT lower bound.

claims.label: prop:boundary
claims.statement: The SAT restriction recurrence plus correct variable-free boundaries determines SAT.
claims.scope: Semantic formula functions; no small-circuit impossibility follows merely from uniqueness.

claims.label: lem:residual
claims.statement: Distinct residual functions characterize minimum width at a cut of a layered ordered diagram.
claims.scope: Deterministic diagrams with fixed order and one read of each input bit.

formal_evidence.scope: L02 only; independent human review remains pending.

claims.label: prop:grouped
claims.statement: The grouped-order disjointness diagram has width 2^m at its midpoint.
claims.scope: Incidence-encoded unit-clause SAT; not arbitrary formula encodings or circuits.

claims.label: prop:interleaved
claims.statement: The interleaved-order diagram has width at most three and linear node count.
claims.scope: Same incidence function; demonstrates representation sensitivity.

claims.label: conj:main
claims.statement: Every pair of polynomial resource bounds fails to describe SAT locally at infinitely many lengths.
claims.scope: Restatement of the established open SAT not in P/poly target; no novelty claimed.

claims.statement: Specialized natural-property characterization using checked SAT solvers.
claims.scope: Chapman-Williams Theorem 1.1; retain the solver restriction.

claims.statement: The specified Gap-MCSP circuit lower bounds magnify to NP not in P/poly.
claims.scope: Oliveira-Pich-Santhanam Theorem 1.4; full-table length, exact promise thresholds, and beta quantifiers.

applicability_audit.result: No transfer established; the full grid-table candidate is eventually on the YES side. The general-circuit antecedent remains open.
applicability_audit.promise: Definition 2.4: YES Size <= s1; NO Size > s2.

claims.statement: The specified conditional time-bounded chain rule characterizes P = NP under an additional hardness hypothesis.
claims.scope: Kabanets-Kolokolova revision 1; NP-hardness assumption is retained.

claims.label: tab:widths
claims.statement: Exhaustive residual counts for 1 <= m <= 7 illustrate P03 and P04.
claims.scope: Exact finite data; no extrapolation as proof.

claims.label: lem:crossing-matching
claims.statement: A whole-graph induced matching of q edges crossing a read/unread cut forces at least 2^q residuals for the independent-set selector function. For maximum degree at most Delta >= 1 and c crossing edges, the layered width is at least 2^(c/(2 Delta^2)).
claims.scope: Finite simple undirected graph fixed per input family; selector bits indicate positive unit clauses added to fixed negative binary clauses. Deterministic layered diagrams read each selector once in a fixed order, allowing arbitrary merging. No general-circuit or conventional-SAT-encoding transfer is claimed.

claims.label: prop:grid-orders
claims.statement: For each even r >= 2, every variable order of the r-by-r grid independent-set selector function requires layered width at least 2^(r/64) after m/2 bits, where m = r^2.
claims.scope: Explicit incidence-encoded SAT family with m selector bits. The lower bound is 2^Omega(sqrt(m)) for all selector orders; the same function has a linear-size general circuit. No claim about SAT not in P/poly, novel lower bounds, or conventional SAT bit encodings.

claims.label: tab:graph-orders
claims.statement: Exact subset dynamic programming computes the minimum maximum layered width over all variable orders for matching-3, cycle-6, grid-2x3, cube-3, and grid-3x3.
claims.scope: Five fixed incidence-encoded graph SAT predicates on 6, 6, 6, 8, and 9 selector bits, respectively. Initial and terminal layers are included. Exact finite data are checked against independent small-case SAT and permutation oracles; no asymptotic proof or factorial enumeration is claimed.

claims.label: lem:graph-signatures
claims.statement: For a finite simple graph and read set S, the exact residual width is the number of distinct unread-neighborhood unions of independent subsets of S, plus one if the induced read graph has an edge.
claims.scope: Fixed graph-selector incidence SAT representation and deterministic layered fixed-order diagrams. Includes empty and full cuts and the graph on no vertices. Looplessness is essential to singleton-suffix separation. No novelty, formal verification, general-circuit lower bound, or conventional-SAT-encoding transfer is claimed.
